hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: On an 8x8 chessboard, the white pieces can always capture the black queen in at most 2 moves.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Check if the rook can capture the queen in 1 move (same row or same column, and the bishop is not strictly between them).

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Check if the bishop can capture the queen in 1 move (same diagonal, and the rook is not strictly between them). If neither holds, return 2.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct coordinate comparisons and obstruction checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph search on chess states is overkill when geometric line-of-sight checks suffice.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify straight-line obstruction conditions on chessboard grids.
